_doc: The Cross: one of Rivet's Stud Driver's salvos (Project Redmond R3, data/gadgets/stud_driver.json): never carried, laid by the driver (its `count` unused; its `use` is where it may go). Nine studs in an X; set off by his detonator, it cuts an X (data/destruction.json `explosives.stud_cross`: two arms 0.6 m wide corner to corner of a 1.5 m square, over a round middle 1.2 m across) through every layer, steel too (a hatch whole). On a wall its middle's bottom is `salvo.ledgeM` over the floor: a ledge a body vaults through. A small blast round it. A bullet into one of its studs destroys it (gadgets/studs.ts); its `sizeM` is its studs' extent. Our own design and numbers.
name: Cross
